content-manager.label: Main Headline
content-manager.description: Large hero headline — keep it punchy, under 6 words.

content-manager.label: Subheadline
content-manager.description: Supporting copy beneath the headline (1–2 sentences).

content-manager.label: Background Video
content-manager.description: Upload the hero video (WebM VP9 + MP4 H.264, muted, ≤ 3 MB).

content-manager.label: Video Poster Image
content-manager.description: Still image shown before the video loads. Must match the video dimensions.

content-manager.label: Primary Action Button
content-manager.description: Main call-to-action button. Leave empty to hide it.

content-manager.label: Secondary Action Button
content-manager.description: Supporting action link or ghost button. Leave empty to hide it.

content-manager.label: Visible on Page?
content-manager.description: Untick to hide this section without deleting it.

content-manager.label: Section Anchor ID
content-manager.description: Optional HTML anchor for deep-linking, e.g. "about". Used in URLs like /page#about.
